name: fluid-property-examples-example3-3-volume-and-energy-change-during-evaporation
source:
m = 0.2
P_atm = 100000
v_f = Volume(Water, P=P_atm, x=0)
v_g = Volume(Water, P=P_atm, x=1)
DELTAV = m * (v_g - v_f)
h_f = Enthalpy(Water, P=P_atm, x=0)
h_g = Enthalpy(Water, P=P_atm, x=1)
E_in = m * (h_g - h_f)
